content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Sells sample storage instruments, consumables and genomic and sample services to the same life science and research lab customers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Makes life science research instruments, reagents and clinical diagnostic kits sold to the same labs and hospitals."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Reimbursement-driven clinical lab testing and patient service networks differ from Revvity's instruments, kits and reagents model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Designs patient monitoring devices and sensors for hospitals and consumers, not lab research tools or diagnostic kits."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Radiation detection and dosimetry for nuclear and defense customers is a different business from life science tools."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer nutritional supplements and NR ingredients, not laboratory instruments, kits or testing for labs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Medical, dental and infection prevention products plus coding and documentation software serve providers, not research labs."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Core business is contract sterilization using radiation or ethylene oxide, a different service from Revvity's lab tools and kits."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud CRM and regulatory software for pharma commercial and quality operations differs from lab instruments and reagents."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Product coding printers and water quality instruments serve manufacturers and utilities, not life science research labs."}]}
